input.command: cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep4/repo; cat .sdd/plan/task-1-brief.md .sdd/plan/task-1-spec.md; ls -R . | grep -v '^./.git' | head -50; cat /private/tmp/msr104-skill/implementer/references/mutants.md
cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep4/repo; cat specs/parking.md; cat plan.md | head -40; ls tests 2>&1

cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep4/repo; mkdir tests; cat > tests/test_parking.py <<'EOF'
from parking import fee


def test_a_short_stay_is_free():
    assert fee(20) == 0


def test_each_started_hour_costs_2():
    assert fee(150) == 6
EOF
PY=/private/tmp/msr104-venv/bin/python
$PY -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -5
cat > parking.py <<'EOF'
FREE_MINUTES = 30
RATE_PER_HOUR = 2


def fee(minutes: int) -> int:
    if minutes <= FREE_MINUTES:
        return 0
    started_hours = -(-minutes // 60)
    return RATE_PER_HOUR * started_hours
EOF
$PY -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -3

cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep4/repo; git status --short; git add parking.py tests/test_parking.py && git commit -q -m "Add the parking fee

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && 
cat >> tests/test_parking.py <<'EOF'


def test_thirty_minutes_is_still_free():
    assert fee(30) == 0


def test_just_over_thirty_minutes_costs_one_hour():
    assert fee(31) == 2


def test_a_whole_hour_costs_one_hour():
    assert fee(60) == 2


def test_one_minute_into_a_second_hour_costs_two_hours():
    assert fee(61) == 4
EOF
PY=/private/tmp/msr104-venv/bin/python; $PY -m pytest -q tests 2>&1|tail -2
git add tests && git commit -q -m "Test the fee at its boundaries" --trailer 'Mutant-step: task 1 input shape' --trailer 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'
W=.sdd/plan
mk(){ sed -i '' "$2" parking.py; git diff -- parking.py > $W/task-1-mutant-$1.patch; git checkout -- parking.py; }
mk 1 's/minutes <= FREE_MINUTES/minutes < FREE_MINUTES/'
mk 2 's/-(-minutes \/\/ 60)/minutes \/\/ 60/'
mk 3 's/RATE_PER_HOUR = 2/RATE_PER_HOUR = 1/'
mk 4 's/FREE_MINUTES = 30/FREE_MINUTES = 60/'
mk 5 's/-(-minutes \/\/ 60)/minutes \/\/ 60 + 1/'
wc -c $W/*.patch
cat > $W/task-1-mutants.md <<'EOF'
# Task 1 mutants

## Inputs

| Rule | Shape | Test |
|---|---|---|
| specs/parking.md:7 | well under the limit | test_a_short_stay_is_free |
| specs/parking.md:7 | exactly 30 minutes | test_thirty_minutes_is_still_free |
| specs/parking.md:9 | just over 30 minutes | test_just_over_thirty_minutes_costs_one_hour |
| specs/parking.md:9 | partial hour | test_each_started_hour_costs_2 |
| specs/parking.md:9 | exact whole hour | test_a_whole_hour_costs_one_hour |
| specs/parking.md:9 | one minute past a whole hour | test_one_minute_into_a_second_hour_costs_two_hours |

## Mutants

Mutant 1: specs/parking.md:7, test_thirty_minutes_is_still_free — 30 minutes is charged — task-1-mutant-1.patch
Mutant 2: specs/parking.md:9, test_each_started_hour_costs_2 — hours rounded down — task-1-mutant-2.patch
Mutant 3: specs/parking.md:9, test_each_started_hour_costs_2 — rate 1 per hour — task-1-mutant-3.patch
Mutant 4: specs/parking.md:7, test_just_over_thirty_minutes_costs_one_hour — free period is 60 minutes — task-1-mutant-4.patch
Mutant 5: specs/parking.md:9, test_a_whole_hour_costs_one_hour, test_one_minute_into_a_second_hour_costs_two_hours — hours as floor+1 — task-1-mutant-5.patch
EOF
git status --short
